files_digest_method: sha256 of the lines '<path> <sha256>\n' for every file, sorted by path
entities_without_comparison_rule: an entity whose first month is after an administration's month 0 did not exist when that administration took office: no rows for it

columns.name: administration
columns.description: administration id (meta administrations; pipeline/crosswalks/administrations.csv)

columns.name: months_in_office
columns.description: N: months in office, month 1 = January of the inauguration year

columns.name: admin_months
columns.description: published months of the administration's window within the entity's span

columns.name: month_0
columns.description: the month before month 1 (YYYY-MM): the baseline of the employee change

columns.name: month_n
columns.description: calendar month of month N (YYYY-MM)

columns.name: time_basis
columns.description: 'effective': flows counted by personnel_action_effective_date_yyyymm (invariant 6)

columns.name: provisional
columns.description: months 1..N contain any of the newest 3 months (invariant 8)

columns.name: partial
columns.description: the administration is still in office (Trump II), or the entity's rows end inside the window

columns.name: reissued
columns.description: month 0 or a month of 1..N changed file version since the previous manifest

columns.name: opm_incomplete
columns.description: month 0 or a month of 1..N is one OPM marks incomplete for this entity (KDI-006)

columns.name: kdi_ids
columns.description: entity-month known data issue ids of month 0 and months 1..N

columns.name: headcount_0
columns.description: headcount at month 0

columns.name: headcount_n
columns.description: headcount at the end of month N

columns.name: headcount_change
columns.description: employee change in office: headcount_n minus headcount_0 (as a percent: / headcount_0); not derived from flows (invariant 7)

columns.name: hires
columns.description: running sum over months 1..N of accession rows by effective month

columns.name: departures
columns.description: running sum over months 1..N of separation rows by effective month (transfers out and DRP included)

columns.name: sep_transfer_out
columns.description: running sum of departures with separation code SA + SB (DRP included)

columns.name: sep_quit
columns.description: running sum of departures with separation code SC (DRP included)

columns.name: sep_retirement
columns.description: running sum of departures with separation code SD + SE + SG (DRP included)

columns.name: sep_rif
columns.description: running sum of departures with separation code SH (DRP included)

columns.name: sep_termination
columns.description: running sum of departures with separation code SJ (DRP included)

columns.name: sep_other
columns.description: running sum of departures with separation code SL (DRP included)

columns.name: sep_drp
columns.description: running sum of departures with drp_indicator = 'Y': the seventh reason with the six _nondrp columns

columns.name: sep_transfer_out_nondrp
columns.description: running sum of departures with separation code SA + SB and drp_indicator not 'Y'; with sep_drp the seven reasons partition departures (why people left)

columns.name: sep_quit_nondrp
columns.description: running sum of departures with separation code SC and drp_indicator not 'Y'; with sep_drp the seven reasons partition departures (why people left)

columns.name: sep_retirement_nondrp
columns.description: running sum of departures with separation code SD + SE + SG and drp_indicator not 'Y'; with sep_drp the seven reasons partition departures (why people left)

columns.name: sep_rif_nondrp
columns.description: running sum of departures with separation code SH and drp_indicator not 'Y'; with sep_drp the seven reasons partition departures (why people left)

columns.name: sep_termination_nondrp
columns.description: running sum of departures with separation code SJ and drp_indicator not 'Y'; with sep_drp the seven reasons partition departures (why people left)

columns.name: sep_other_nondrp
columns.description: running sum of departures with separation code SL and drp_indicator not 'Y'; with sep_drp the seven reasons partition departures (why people left)

columns.name: acc_transfer_in
columns.description: running sum of hires with accession code AA + AB

columns.name: acc_new_hire
columns.description: running sum of hires with accession code AC + AD + AE

columns.name: attrition_num
columns.description: departures over months 1..N x 12 / N (annualized departure rate numerator); rate = attrition_num / rate_den

columns.name: hire_num
columns.description: hires over months 1..N x 12 / N (annualized hire rate numerator); rate = hire_num / rate_den

columns.name: rate_den
columns.description: mean month-end headcount over months 1..N; null (never 0) when that mean is 0

columns.name: rate_months
columns.description: N, the months averaged into rate_den

columns.name: rate_small_base
columns.description: rate_den < 30 (invariant 9); null when the rate is empty
